name: Kaicho Oonojo
source:
Fujitaka Student Council's third year high school student. She is the student council president who is beautiful, perfect, devilish, and is loved by all Fujitaka students. Her silver hair seems to be natural.

[Translated from [url=https://sonokoi-horyu.net/character/]official website[/url]]
